resolved_conflicts.field: fate of the 1954 cabin at West Maury
resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS says the 14x14 cabin there was removed in 1970; firelookout.com says it was destroyed that year. The story reports both wordings and does not pick one.

The Oregon Lookouts page quotes 1934 notices about an emergency station on Maury Mountain, six years before the 1940 cabin. The page does not say they were the same point, so the story keeps them apart.

notes_for_editor: Brief record checked: status gone, FFLOS registration June 12, 2011 and Crook County/Ochoco NF all confirmed. The brief's access 'unknown' is omitted because no source gives access. The cabin's link to West Maury rests on the 1954 date plus the Arrow Wood sources; the West Maury pages never name Arrow Wood. The 1981 tDAR record 161708 (Bedortha, 'Commercial Thinning and Cultural Resource Property Management of the Arrow Wood, Double Cabin, Friday, Parrish, West Maury or Big Daddy') may describe the site in the field but its abstract did not load, so it is not cited. Cross-check the 1934 Central Oregonian notices if a newspaper search is possible; they are quoted only on the Oregon Lookouts page.
